description_en: Changes the routing protocol of a Smart Access Gateway (SAG) instance
description_zh: 调用ModifySagGlobalRouteProtocol修改全局路由协议
kebab_example: aliyun smartag modify-sag-global-route-protocol --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --smart-ag-id sag-whfn0000 --smart-ag-sn sag32a300000 --route-protocol OSPF --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifySagGlobalRouteProtocol

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the SAG instance
parameters.help_zh: 智能接入网关实例地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the SAG instance
parameters.name: smart_ag_id

parameters.help_en: The serial number of the SAG device that is associated with the SAG instance
parameters.help_zh: 绑定的智能接入网关设备序列号
parameters.name: smart_ag_sn

parameters.help_en:
The routing protocol. Valid values:

STATIC: static routing protocol
OSPF: Open Shortest Path First protocol (OSPF)
BGP: Border Gateway Protocol (BGP)
parameters.help_zh:
路由协议。取值：

STATIC：静态路由协议。
OSPF：OSPF动态路由协议。
BGP：BGP动态路由协议
parameters.name: route_protocol
